title: Puzzle 3d End To End
description: Get puzzle 3d working end to end: `bun dev:puzzle:3d` must boot, every window must show a different working example, and the fill tool (and other editor tools) must work at runtime. Currently the dev script dies because `semio-s-plugin-stdio` fails to compile (11 x E0080 'erroneous constant' from the `dsl::Mutations` derive across artifact mutation enums: gif/89a, bcf/2.1, avi/1.0, ...), which fails the flow-core wasm build. Fix the build, then verify the app boots and each puzzle 3d window renders its example and the fill tool runs.
